observable_failure_step.description: Executed script that failed with AssertionError: replacements_count is 1, expected 6

root_cause_diagnosis: The candidate script hardcoded search strings with literal numbering prefixes ('۱) ', '۲) ', etc.). In Word OpenXML, list numbering is stored in paragraph properties (<w:pPr><w:numPr>) and is NOT present in run text (<w:r><w:t>). The actual text inside paragraphs 288-292 starts directly with 'سبک های دلبستگی...' without any '۱) ' prefix. Consequently, the replacement logic failed for all 5 hypotheses, matching only Section 6C Item 3, leading to an AssertionError during the benchmark test.
prescribed_behavior: Search for exact run text stripped of assumed OpenXML numPr prefixes or match by paragraph content normalized of numPr.
